summary: @Cambridgeport90 Yeah currently most #smallpoems stuff is on Mastodon but we created a #clmooc webring and syndicate all of our posts to an RSS planet. This was the first time folks were trying to syndicate using webmentions. Most are WordPress users.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@Cambridgeport90 Yeah currently most #smallpoems stuff is on Mastodon but we created a #clmooc webring and syndicate all of our posts to an RSS planet.

This was the first time folks were trying to syndicate using webmentions. Most are WordPress users.
